master.requirement: Границы retrieval composition: Bounded recipes/fallback/rescue допустимы в ragy. General workflow — flowy, agent loop/UI/Ask–Plan–Action — harness; не создавать новую библиотеку на каждую retrieval стратегию.
master.rationale: Bounded retrieval strategies remain domain composition; general workflow and agent loop stay host-owned.

master.requirement: Два composition engines и ranking façade: Свести result-only и execution-aware внутренние engines, если это уменьшит drift; inventory consumers перед удалением ranking compatibility aliases. Без второго legacy engine ради совместимости.
master.rationale: Consumer inventory preceded removal. All result-only syntax delegates to RequestExecutionPipeline with NoExecutionMeta, removing duplicate dispatch/planning algorithms while preserving former ranking tests.

master.requirement: Merger fallback: Ошибка custom fusion сейчас ведёт к score merge с error. Это documented degradation, но лучше explicit policy/original observed sets; не сравнивать разные score scales автоматически.
master.rationale: No implicit comparisons across score scales. Ordinary FusionFailureError retains branch inputs; host explicitly selects DegradingMerger. Protection/cancellation never degrade or expose diagnostics.

master.requirement: Zero ExecMeta: reflect.DeepEqual(zero) означает omitted и мешает reset в корректный zero. При clean break ввести presence/update contract или всегда уважать returned value, без reflective угадывания.
master.rationale: Returned Executed including zero is authoritative; no reflective presence inference.

master.requirement: Partial result/error authority: Согласовать separate ResultSet и nested PartialFailureError.Result, сохранить outer causes при errors.Join/As. Не объявлять source-level подозрение отдельным доказанным багом.
master.rationale: Separately returned set is sole payload authority. As views synchronize diagnostics without mutating host errors; original outer/joined causes remain inspectable. Final delivery also suppresses stale diagnostics.

master.requirement: Nil callbacks и resolver defaults: Унифицировать constructor validation; custom ResultSet не обязан быть built-in для сохранения resolver. Explicit resolver capability/argument лучше молчаливого default.
master.rationale: Required typed-nil ports reject; optional nil/typed-nil resolver explicitly defaults to document ID. Invalid processor sentinel preserves constructor shape. ResolverProvider lets custom sets retain identity through normalization.

master.requirement: Threshold stage: Различить pre-postprocessor и terminal threshold, reranked/native score. Raw BM25/персистентные backends должны явно сообщать поддержку options; не выдавать topK за work cap.
master.rationale: Chain input threshold precedes processors; pipeline terminal threshold follows optional chain. Explicit score state/semantics prohibit inferred native/reranked comparisons; TopK is delivery count, not work cap. Backend-specific option claims remain adapter contracts.

master.requirement: MergeKey и evidence equality: Winner merge может объединять supports разных texts, RRF строже. Определить semantic grouping vs identical evidence; GroupBy остаётся явной сборкой content.
master.rationale: Business identity does not attest equal content/metadata. Different losing payload contributes no support/history to winner; equal payload union and strict RRF remain, GroupBy explicitly assembles text.

master.requirement: Config/metadata ownership: Документировать freeze/clone для Artifact pointer, SynonymMap, Run config и BYOT metadata. Host callbacks остаются cooperative/concurrency-safe; не blanket JSON deep-copy всего.
master.rationale: Recipe snapshots Artifact options/Diagnostics; builder rebind owns aggregate node slice. Arbitrary BYOT/callback state remains host-owned and stable. SynonymMap adapter-specific freeze is assigned to T16, not claimed here.

master.requirement: Budget semantics: Calls не refunded, unknown usage reserved, ledger scope может быть shared. Развести known tokens и known cost при необходимости; это не организация billing/quota и не metry ledger.
master.rationale: Calls are dispatch accounting and never refunded; unknown usage retains reservation. Known is a full supplied tokens/cost tuple, so unknown cost cannot become known zero. Supplied ledger scope is host-selected; RunOwn independent. No billing abstractions.

master.requirement: Model-free attestation: Это declaration host, не sandbox. UnsupportedQueryEncoderBridge не должен хранить неиспользуемый Embedder; explicit unsupported, без скрытого model call.
master.rationale: Model-free remains honest host attestation, not sandboxing. Removed unused Embedder field from rejecting bridge; incapable hard token bounds reject before provider I/O.

master.requirement: Counts против bytes/work: MaxDocuments, candidate count, cache entries и retained snapshots не гарантируют bounded RSS/CPU. Описать конкретные units/limits и trusted bounded callbacks, не хардкодить универсальный cap.
master.rationale: Document/cache/query caps count populations, not bytes/RSS/CPU. Ports remain cooperative and must enforce declared model text/token bounds. No arbitrary hidden universal cap.

master.requirement: Cache/copy cost: MemoryCache O(capacity) eviction и repeated result slice copies измерять; byte budget/singleflight только по потребности. Никакого refresh daemon/distributed cache по умолчанию.
master.rationale: No cache/copy optimization or speedup claimed: existing O(capacity) eviction and cloning outside lock retain ownership/freshness. Before/after is N/A for unchanged cache/copy algorithms; measure profiles before optimization. No singleflight/refresh/distributed service introduced.

master.requirement: Fallback vs Rescue: Сохранить отличие empty-success от empty-error. Nil conditional predicate и rank degradation должны быть явной configuration policy, не неочевидным разрешением dispatch.
master.rationale: Fallback routes empty success; Rescue routes empty ordinary errors, never partial/protection. Nil conditional predicate now invalid; explicit false skips. No implicit rank degradation.

master.requirement: Publication terminology: Развести source→manifest pointer, immutable read capture и durable metadata pin в глоссарии/названиях. Capture не lease, Acquire pin защищает metadata, не source/target payload availability.
master.rationale: Keep names to avoid gratuitous churn; current guide distinguishes source pointer, immutable read capture and durable metadata reservation. Capture not lease; pin metadata not payload/authorization.

master.requirement: Capture namespace check: Удалить tautology snapshot.Namespace!=namespace, сравнить requested namespace после Store.Load. Custom misrouted Store repro подтверждает hardening gap; native filestore cross-tenant defect не найден, F-счётчик не увеличивать.
master.rationale: Retain requested namespace across Store.Load before deriving publication; mismatched or malformed response yields protocol zero/no writes. Remove helper tautology. Custom Store hardening, not a new native/F defect.

master.requirement: Lifecycle CAS/reuse: Namespace-wide CAS консервативен; positive CheckReuse — observation point, не permission/lease. Уточнить comment: только positive confirmation повторно проверяет generation. Retry/reconcile выбирает host.
master.rationale: Namespace generation remains conservative across sources/pins. Only positive reuse rechecks generation; all decisions are observations, not leases/permission. Host reloads/reconciles rather than hidden retry.

master.requirement: Lifecycle unknown/cleanup: Read-only inspect может вернуть OutcomeUnknown без разрушительного вызова. Cleaner делает один шаг и выдаёт schedule/backoff; Complete не означает forensic/source erasure. Дать operation-specific recovery table.
master.rationale: Retain finite Executor/Cleaner steps. Current guide separates dispatch unknown, read-only inspection unknown and CAS acknowledgment unknown, plus host clock/backoff/overdue recovery and Complete scope.

master.requirement: Постоянные reservations: Retired skeletons, released IDs, digests и receipts нужны против ABA. Не TTL-delete и не auto-evict при capacity; миграция/retention policy принадлежат host.
master.rationale: Permanent retired skeletons/digests/released IDs/bootstrap+cleanup receipts prevent ABA/rebinding and preserve replay. Capacity never evicts automatically; metadata retention and payload cleanup separate.

master.requirement: Lifecycle boundedness/clone: Finite port calls не равны constant CPU/bytes: full snapshot и scans растут с history. Оптимизация через temporary indexes/explicit deep clone — после замеров и differential validation.
master.rationale: Finite call count is not CPU/bytes/RSS bound. Whole history validation/scans/serialization and JSON ownership clone remain unchanged. No optimization/speedup claimed; before/after N/A. Future optimization requires measured profile and differential ownership/order validation.

master.requirement: Plan equality/CAS authority: Порядок artifacts/targets может быть частью idempotency. Не менять canonicalization существующих reservations молча. Raw CompareSwap — trusted low-level interface, не authenticated command API.
master.rationale: Plan target/artifact order remains semantic to reserved replay; capture sorting does not authorize reordering plans. Raw CAS is trusted checkpoint port with mandatory ValidateReplacement, not command authorization.

master.requirement: Inventory fences: Сохранить sorted locks, exact-once synchronous observer callback и exact inventory. Нет принудительного прерывания arbitrary callback через unbounded goroutines.
master.rationale: Sorted simultaneous inventory fences and exactly-once synchronous cooperative callback preserve exact inventory. No goroutine detachment, implicit workers or distributed commitment claim.

master.requirement: Graph ingestion scope: Extraction/resolution/materialization/history — retrieval-domain facts/provenance. Ontology, aliases, semantic truth, model transport и lifecycle driving — host.
master.rationale: Keep independent source-bound retrieval facts/provenance ports; general orchestration and semantic policies stay host-owned.

master.requirement: Relation closure/naming: Source-local endpoint support обязателен по контракту; пример cross-document relation. Name — canonical, не mention label; рассмотреть CanonicalName/MentionKind вместо перегруженного Kind.
master.rationale: Keep source-local endpoint closure and existing JSON names; Name is canonical and Unresolved.Kind has entity/relation literals. Cross-document example explains real evidence requirement.

master.requirement: Graph generic kinds/history: Stable comparable enum/value и faithful bounded JSON callbacks — host contract. History capture не пересчитывает ontology и не доказывает policy truth; maxSupports также считает другие populations.
master.rationale: Stable reflexive comparable kinds and faithful bounded codecs are host requirements; actual resolver records are declared decisions, with explicit multidimensional occurrence accounting.

master.requirement: Graph history bytes/platform: Marshal cap — accepted wire, не peak allocation. FileStore darwin/linux и host-prepared durable root описать явно; no automatic retention/retry после unknown append.
master.rationale: Accepted serialized-byte cap is post-Marshal, not peak-memory; portable snapshots versus darwin/linux local FileStore, durable root and unknown append inspection explicit.

master.requirement: Graph scaling: Support unions/variant grouping и summary admission могут быть quadratic. Сначала benchmark upper bounds; map[Locator] со stable order допустим, новая indexing framework не нужна.
master.rationale: No speculative indexing/copy optimization. Actual declared-max resolver and isolated union/admission benchmarks recorded; stable ownership/order/freshness retained, before/after optimization N/A.

master.requirement: Extraction full-input budget: MaxInputBytes сейчас source-text only, не весь model envelope. Назвать точно или отдельный envelope cap; CountInputTokens должен учитывать реальный provider input.
master.rationale: Extraction composes independent local and ledger remaining durations, gates each clock at host callback/project/clone/delivery boundaries and settles once. MaxInputBytes is explicitly source-text only; CountInputTokens covers the actual complete provider envelope.

master.requirement: Summary dependencies: Selected citations не равны всем model derivation inputs. Уточнить revocation policy для unselected input; при необходимости separate dependency inventory. Structural association не semantic truth.
master.rationale: Retain selected-citation future Resolve policy. Unselected inputs are not complete derivation dependencies; full revocation requires externally retained map/reduction ancestry, with boundary regression.

master.requirement: Summary delivery/coverage: Resolve проверяет текущий доступ; возвращённый MappedText уже owned и не отзывается задним числом. Coverage — declared set coverage, не качество prose, MissingCoverage не запускает hidden repair.
master.rationale: Fresh Resolve checks original binding and selected supports; delivered data is owned. Membership is declared set coverage; first incomplete community stops later maps/reduce without repair.

master.requirement: Graph recipe heuristics: Seed-only graph как Insufficient и fail-zero при node/edge limit — explicit policies. Volatile managed graph не восстанавливается из одного manifest; не fallback на raw/current graph.
master.rationale: Keep seed-only Insufficient recipe heuristic, fail-zero capacities and volatile unavailable without fallback; explicit smaller depth versus capacity guidance.

master.requirement: Error precedence в graph recipes: Graphsummary/graphexpand/extraction также могут скрыть callback/settle causes за gate. Расширить F01 acceptance на эти пути; отдельный payload-release defect там не доказан.
master.rationale: Extraction/graphexpand/graphsummary join callback/settlement/gate causes. Summary accepts only direct pre-dispatch budget stops, never joined callback failure.

master.requirement: Materialization/ergonomics: Build validation не обязательно возвращает normalized metadata. Определить normalization stage, дать минимальную композицию generics/callbacks; не добавлять DI builder framework.
master.rationale: Build returns original owned projected metadata after normalized-view validation; managed Stage sorts/compacts labels and captures normalized filter attributes, retaining separately cloned typed metadata. Full existing deterministic five-type example remains runnable with all callback and lifecycle handoff guidance.

master.requirement: Chunk overlap/separators: Overlap применяется лишь fixed-splitting fallback; описать best-effort либо реализовать boundary overlap. Custom non-whitespace delimiters могут исчезать — explicit keep/drop policy и coverage properties.
master.rationale: Retain fallback-only best-effort overlap and explicit conditional boundary separator omissions; source coordinate and readable grammar regressions document retained behavior.

master.requirement: Markdown/sentence heuristics: Hash-line splitter не полноценный Markdown, punctuation sentence splitter не NLP. Назвать поддерживаемую грамматику, учесть code fences/Setext либо дать BYO ports, без скрытых моделей.
master.rationale: Retain hash-line Markdown and punctuation sentence heuristics with explicit fenced-code/Setext/abbreviation limitations and BYO segmenter. No hidden model/NLP fallback.

master.requirement: Segment/chunk admission: Определить allowed gaps, Total0, unmapped UTF-8 и Index ordering. Проверять trusted callback contract пропорционально; не выдумывать source coordinates без оригинала.
master.rationale: Reject substantive segment omissions and invalid UTF-8 chunk/context. Entire ordered contextual batch admitted before callbacks with Total0 convention, source/index/knownTotal/exact supplied InputSpan validation; remove sort that rescued invalid indices.

master.requirement: Projection partial/identity: Унифицировать all-or-nothing vs partial projection. Descriptor/chunk identity precedence, StorageID для всех chunks и URI MergeKey требуют ясной authority; не global ID service.
master.rationale: Projection errors uniformly return no payload. Default descriptor/chunk source IDs must agree; optional ID fallback, URI MergeKey and source-level shared StorageID explicitly remain host identity policy.

master.requirement: Source ownership/RawStore: Reader Catalog→admitted Loader и no-latest гарантии сохранить. RawStore — explicit unscoped administration. Project получает уже authorized document, Binding сам не доказывает его принадлежность scope.
master.rationale: Retain authoritative Catalog/admitted Loader/owned payload/rechecks/no-latest and unscoped RawStore; borrowed immutable metadata and already-authorized layout input remain explicit host preconditions.

master.requirement: Mapping strictness/attestation: Persisted mapping JSON менее строг locator/evidence wire; решить duplicate/case/Unicode policy. Structural mapping не доказательство exact source text — нужен authorized resolve, не «защита» hash-ом.
master.rationale: Keep ordinary mapping JSON profile with documented duplicate later-value/case aliases/Unicode repair/missing-zero semantics rather than imply strict untrusted-wire authentication. Existing structural validation and retained authenticated Resolve remain authority; canonical host storage accepts Marshal output only.

master.requirement: Source/layout cost/supports: Повторное UTF-8 scanning каждого span может быть O(words×text). Validate once на trusted snapshot boundary. Slice сохраняет broad support ancestry; whole media Resolve не crop API.
master.rationale: Realistic 512/2048-word baseline justified one UTF-8 snapshot validation per OriginalTexts batch and MappedText.Validate. Region resolution uses batch; beforeafter measurements and boundary/ownership/order differential tests preserve all shape checks and broad support ancestry, whole media unchanged.

master.requirement: OCR/image projection: Partial coverage и original-vs-derived distinctions сохранить. ImageText callback явно заменяет OCR даже при empty output; описать или explicit host policy, не hidden fallback.
master.rationale: Retain partial derived OCR, whole-document coverage and explicit ImageText replacement including empty override; no implicit fallback or fabricated original text.

master.requirement: Multimodal URL: Transport-neutral URL не downloader/SSRF policy service. Providers валидируют supported schemes/MIME, host — network allowlist; trim/normalization и inactive fields согласовать.
master.rationale: Require valid UTF-8 text and literal empty inactive fields; preserve transport-neutral trimmed absolute URL validation without rewriting, provider schemes/wire and host network credentials/allowlist.

master.requirement: Evidence scope/bounds: Membership tuple без Transformation может означать original source, не index artifact. Зафиксировать семантику; rank int→float64 ограничить meaningful ordinal domain; output wire cap не входной CPU bound.
master.rationale: Original-source membership deliberately excludes index transformation/target. Capture and Decode enforce exact positive float64 ordinal domain MaxExactRank; work/metadata/mapping/contribution prebounds explicitly host-owned beyond output caps.

master.requirement: Tensor score/work: MaxSim может быть negative/>1, Dot не требует normalized input. Candidate-bound != token×dimension bound; ctx checks между rows/candidates и limits нужны по профилю, не implicit clamping.
master.rationale: Metric-dependent shapes/native scores retained; validation observes row/candidate cancellation and discards results. Candidate count is not token/dimension/CPU budget.

master.requirement: Candidate catalog semantics: Exact-within-candidates не ANN/exhaustive. Budget считает docs, projection dedup считает refs; catalog scan шире payload budget. MaxRecords не должен скрывать несколько независимых units.
master.rationale: Exact scoring stays within supplied candidates; backend-document budget precedes first-occurrence reference dedup. Catalog scanning is broader; all distinct MaxRecords units are documented.

master.requirement: Lexical cache/config: Snapshot count не byte/transient-builder cap; generation-wide invalidation безопасна. B=0/K1=0 как default мешает математическим zero значениям — optional config при clean break. Borrowed raw metadata явно ограничивает concurrency.
master.rationale: Optional copied BM25 parameter aggregate supports explicit K1/B zeros; resident snapshot count and concurrent transient builds remain distinct. Generation-wide invalidation and raw host borrowing retained.

master.requirement: Повторные admission passes: Некоторые clone/build/check нужны для ownership/freshness; объединять только с fence tests. CPU scoring/sorting BM25 требует cancellation checkpoints при больших corpora.
master.rationale: BM25 checks cancellation during score accumulation and result construction; sorts and snapshot copies remain indivisible cooperative work, with no performance optimization claim. Repeated clone/admission/build gates fence different ownership/publication transitions; retain without consolidation or optimization claims. Existing callback/cache/fence regressions remain required.

master.requirement: Local file profile: fsync files/root не доказывает power-loss mkdir ancestor durability. Явный pre-provisioned root либо synced init при нужном контракте; не заявлять hardware crash verification по process-crash tests.
master.rationale: Trusted preprovisioned local roots/ancestors and process-crash profile; file/root sync does not prove ancestor or hardware power-loss durability. Flock contention is nonblocking; handle/open-file-description lifetime, no network filesystem promise.

master.requirement: Filesystem boundaries: Nonblocking flock конфликт возвращает host; describe handle/OS semantics, no networkFS fallback. Trusted root не hostile filesystem sandbox. Explicit Retired check полезен, native retired-payload bypass не подтверждён.
master.rationale: Explicitly reject Retired in both selectors, including a retired duplicate beside one live match. Hardening is not a newly confirmed native payload bypass. Trusted preprovisioned local roots/ancestors and process-crash profile; file/root sync does not prove ancestor or hardware power-loss durability. Flock contention is nonblocking; handle/open-file-description lifetime, no network filesystem promise.

master.requirement: Dense/tensor duplication: Узкий internal helper для inventory/cleanup может сократить drift; не публичный универсальный storage engine, скрывающий gates и type-specific validation.
master.rationale: Keep visible type-specific validation/catalog/publication gates; narrow mechanics already share durablefs. Generic storage engine or hidden-gate helper has no demonstrated benefit; no clone/CPU optimization claimed.

master.requirement: Storage codec/filter contract: PG custom codec получает json.Number, ES/Qdrant normalized scalar: согласовать input types/empty attrs. Portable missing/null/wrong-kind truth table и constructor sentinel errors нужны независимо от SQL.
master.rationale: PG now normalizes UseNumber attributes before custom Decode, including empty wire. Present schema-canonical kinds and nil/empty equivalence match ES/Qdrant; malformed present values fail admission. Portable omission booleans remain two-valued; present null/wrong-kind/nonfinite values require admission rejection. MatchIR lookup is pre-normalized, not arbitrary public metadata. Existing exhaustive parity verifies nested logic and all kinds. Nil/zero/unfinalized builder failures classify ErrInvalidArgument consistently. Final schema name/kind validation remains the provenance boundary.

master.requirement: ES tokenizer/config: SynonymMap следует clone/freeze; tokenize один раз и передавать результат. Stateful tokenizer не должен менять preflight и dispatched query; не новый tokenizer framework.
master.rationale: ES deep-owns synonyms and fields; tokenize/expand once then reuse exact tokens for admission and dispatch. Stable/concurrent host callbacks retained; mutation/stateful fixture tests actual wire.

master.requirement: PG identifiers/batch/order: Unquoted safe regex защищает injection, но uppercase/keywords требуют policy/quoting. Upsert batch bound host-owned без hidden chunked partial commits. Equal-distance tie order определить с учётом ANN planning.
master.rationale: Quote validated single ASCII table names, preserving case/keywords with no schema-qualified expansion. Retain host-bounded one-statement atomic batches, unspecified equal-distance ties and cleanup-only Close with authoritative Rows.Err.

master.requirement: Bridge capability honesty: Neo4j — Runner bridge, не native driver; generic Filters mapping/rejection и projection validation явны. Unknown affected counts не заменять длиной input. Local wire tests не certification live scope enforcement.
master.rationale: Reject generic Filters before Runner; graph-domain NodeFilter/EdgeFilter are explicit. Retrieve validates only document projection and ordinary prefixes; Traverse/Upsert validate full snapshots. T10 cancellation/private-cause regression restored locally and covered by retained delivery tests. Keep explicit host transport/Runner boundaries: no native driver, retry, DDL, migration or remote attestation. Local wire tests do not certify server enforcement; actual isolated PG profile separately checks tenant/omission/exact integers, unsupported pins remain explicit. Keep exact-only nonnegative counts; host must resolve unknown/asynchronous outcomes or return unsupported/error, never infer ID count. Negative/unrepresentable PG and negative Qdrant reports fail protocol; no fabricated unknown zero success. Direct Options.Filters/Plan.Filters/Plan.Ranges all reject before Runner; reviewed revision closes planned-channel omission. Native scoped Binding tenant pairs >2^53, omission, conflicting optional predicate and unsupported pinned-before-I/O are tested separately from unrestricted SQL predicate parity.

master.requirement: Provider transports: Shared URL/error contract tests предотвращают F10/F11 drift; structured usage/schema semantics не обязательно объединять с embedding client. Consistent cancellation/I/O/protocol taxonomy и credential preflight.
master.rationale: Shared T11 URL/context helpers retained; ordinary structured Doer failures align with ErrUnavailable, body failures stay ErrProtocol. Shared UTF-8/control/blank credential admission runs in all constructors before dispatch.

master.requirement: Provider JSON/schema: Unknown fields evolution отдельно от duplicate/case/surrogate policy. Structured choice Index missing/null требует explicit admission; executable domain schema host-owned, не новый universal validator.
master.rationale: Structured choice index requires nonnull zero with known usage preserved. Unknown-field evolution, exact decoded duplicate rejection, case aliases and surrogate normalization have separate explicit policies; host executable schema retained.

master.requirement: Space/config naming: Model/Space.Model дублируются; ModelRevision/Configuration — host attestation, не remote fact. MaxOutputTokens для tensor rows лучше MaxVectorRows. Defaults/explicit limits и Cohere query+docs accounting описать таблицей.
master.rationale: Space remains authoritative; Model convenience equality assertion retained explicitly. Host attestation is separate from optional model echo. MaxVectorRows clean rename completed after inventory; shared defaults/explicit units table published.

master.requirement: Usage/error materialization: Известный usage не должен теряться только из-за rejected vectors; где неизвестен, не оценивать как known. Cohere retained input/prefix с error не считать reranked success; billing/prices остаются host.
master.rationale: Independent valid usage precedes delayed raw model/vector/shape/index JSON decode and semantic admission; known usage survives malformed payload members/float32 overflow, rejected model/cardinality/vectors and postdecode cancellation without embeddings. Invalid/absent counters and malformed/truncated whole envelopes remain unknown. Shared optional model echo decoder has post-decode context gates.

master.requirement: PDF limits/errors: Catch-all invalid_pdf скрывает engine bugs; sanitized internal class рассмотреть отдельно. Output limits не гарантируют RSS/CPU. Документировать tested Python deps/fingerprint/real parser opt-in, host process isolation вне core.
master.rationale: Recognized parser read/syntax errors are invalid input; only private declared limit/geometry exceptions select invalid/unsupported. Unexpected dependency OverflowError/NotImplementedError and implementation errors are internal unavailable without raw text. Actual runtime/dependency/fingerprint and 11-class fault profile published; no RSS/CPU claim.

master.requirement: Observation boundaries: Сохранить bounded enums, known/unknown, payload-free events и synchronous serialized callbacks. Pair/drop/event units описать; custom error.Is/Unwrap не sandbox. Adapter to metry optional, без exporter daemon.
master.rationale: Fixed payload-free diagnostic enums, observed known/unknown counters and synchronous serialized sessions retained; exact pair/callback/failure units and cooperative custom-error boundary published. Optional OTel/metry remains host port without core exporter workers/retries.

master.requirement: Docs/CI/release surface: Current guides вынести из task/.cursor chronology; убрать blanket word blacklist в пользу symbol/snippet tests. Standalone GOWORK=off CI, fresh acceptance и publishable-module manifest отдельно от example modules.
P1: deadline превращает protection failure в успешный partial result

master.rationale: Reviewed source is fetched into isolated checkout; tracked publishable-module manifest and exact staged file/ref allowlists exclude caller private files/unrelated tags. Dirty index and tag collisions fail before candidate preparation.

master.requirement: P2: ошибка release оставляет detached HEAD и занятую версию
master.rationale: Persist exact source/version/candidate and owned refs before publication, reconcile exact remote objects to explicit none/partial/complete/unknown/collision, and resume the same candidate without altering caller checkout or deleting refs.

master.requirement: P2: extraction не соблюдает более ранний deadline общего ledger
master.rationale: Extraction composes independent local and ledger remaining durations, gates each clock at host callback/project/clone/delivery boundaries and settles once. MaxInputBytes is explicitly source-text only; CountInputTokens covers the actual complete provider envelope.

master.requirement: P2: resolver объединяет разные identity keys из-за JSON UTF-8 repair
master.rationale: Reject malformed UTF-8 configuration/input and host identity decisions/keys before framed JSON hashing/grouping; retain valid hashes, U+FFFD and host normalization ownership. History admits the same identity domain before serialization and decoded inventory delivery.

master.requirement: P2: layout допускает один exact source reference для разных текстов
master.rationale: Unique exact normalized page text references enforced during full Document admission before Project/ImageText; retain full-selector cell/image sharing and unchanged source location hashing with explicit host loader/attestation limits.

master.requirement: P2: BM25Snapshot вызывает следующий codec после отмены чтения
master.rationale: Per-codec pre/post read gates across scoring, snapshot capture/build and managed misses; post-clone gates precede ordinary errors. Protection discards all candidates before next callback/output clone, retains raw borrowed metadata and existing ranking/ordinary partial policy. Scoped protected cause boundary retains callback errors.Is identity/classification while hiding private text and payload-bearing error siblings, including final delivery.

master.requirement: P2: pgvector отрицание расходится с portable filter на absent fields
master.rationale: Normalize PostgreSQL scalar leaves before boolean composition; shared admitted-domain fixtures compare core truth with actual PostgreSQL query and delete IDs.
